changes.to: Media (2026-11-17): press photo of CLOiD folding laundry from LG's own CES 2026 release (4 Jan 2026). That release states height adjusts from 105 to 143 cm, 7-DoF arms and a wheeled base; it carries no video asset. | LG newsroom (checked 2026-11-17): a head unit, torso with two arms and a wheeled autonomous base; torso height adjustable from 1,050 to 1,430 mm, arms about 87 cm long, 7 DoF per arm (shoulder 3, elbow 1, wrist 3) and five independently actuated fingers per hand. Total DoF, weight, speed and battery are not published. Shown at CES 2026; no sale price or order route.

Issue #17 (2026-11-17): LG publishes only the dual 7-DoF arms and an adjustable working height of about 1.05-1.43 m (143 cm taken as standing height); weight, payload, speed, runtime and total DoF are all undisclosed, so they stay empty.

changes.from: Wheeled (bimanual torso on a wheeled base) humanoid from LG Electronics; announced, restricted sales.
changes.to: LG's wheeled home robot: two 7-DoF arms with five-fingered hands on a self-driving base, torso height adjustable from 1.05 to 1.43 m, with a head unit that doubles as an AI home hub. Shown at CES 2026.
